title: Snapshot
description: v1 snapshot: full list of 128-bit entry hashes (schemas/canonical-key.md), sorted ascending, Ed25519-signed. No deltas, filters or confirm step (v1 cut list).

entries.description: Lowercase hex, sorted ascending, no duplicates (ordering is checked by tests, not expressible here).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the payload defined in schemas/snapshot-signing.md, standard base64.
